name: three-dev
description: three.dev's official agent plugin: the three-dev-setup skill adds three.dev to a codebase, the three-dev-failure-modes skill investigates failures in the LLM traffic three.dev records, and the three.dev MCP server connects your agent to three.dev.

interface.shortDescription: Set up three.dev, triage failures, fix them
interface.longDescription: three.dev's official agent plugin. The three-dev-setup skill wires OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Bedrock or LiteLLM clients through the three.dev proxy with use cases, sessions and tags. The three-dev-failure-modes skill investigates failures in the LLM traffic three.dev records, reads the conversations behind them and proposes a fix. The three.dev MCP server connects your agent to three.dev.
defaultPrompt: What are the worst failure modes for my use case this week?
Why is my LLM feature failing in production?
